item.title: HM Amit Shah to visit Gujarat tomorrow
item.description: Ahmedabad: Union Home Minister Amit Shah is scheduled to visit Gujarat again on January 27, marking another significant engagement in his home state this month. During this visit, Shah will attend a special religious programme at the historic Kalupur Swaminarayan Temple in Ahmedabad, where a grand congregation has been organised by the temple trust to commemorate 200 years of the writing of the Shikshapatri, a foundational scripture of the Swaminarayan Sampradaya. item.title: Ratha Saptami celebrations held amid spiritual ambience at Kanaka Durga temple
item.description: Vijayawada: Ratha Saptami festivities were celebrated in a grand and devotional manner at the renowned Sri Durga Malleswara Swamy Varla Devasthanam atop Indrakeeladri in Vijayawada on Sunday, marking the auspicious occasion of Magha Shuddha Saptami.The celebrations were held in a highly spiritual atmosphere, drawing a large number of devotees to witness the special rituals and offer prayers. Special pujas were performed for Lord Surya at a dedicated mandapam arranged within the temple premises.

item.title: India Highlights Military Might And Cultural Diversity At 77th Republic Day Parade
item.description: The 77th Republic Day parade showcased India’s defence capabilities, new military units, and rich cultural diversity, with first-time appearances by newly raised regiments and unique ceremonial contingents.

item.title: Red chilli prices touch new highs at Guntur mirchi yard
item.description: Guntur: Red chilli prices have surged to record levels at Asia’s largest Guntur Mirchi Yard, driven by strong demand in both domestic and international markets and a significant decline in production during the current season compared to last year.According to Mirchi Yard officials, premium varieties have witnessed a sharp price rise of 20 to 25 per cent over last year. item.title: Andhra Loyola College alumni meet organised
item.description: Vijayawada: The alumni of Andhra Loyola College who pursued their Intermediate and B.Com studies between 1970 and 1975 organised a reunion meet at the college premises today. item.title: Operation Sindoor Takes Centre Stage At Republic Day 2026, Showcasing India’s Defence Strength
item.description: Operation Sindoor was prominently showcased at the 77th Republic Day parade, highlighting India’s zero-tolerance stance on terrorism, indigenous defence capabilities, and joint military strength.

item.title: A Strong India Brings Global Stability: EU Chief Signals Momentum On Historic Trade Deal
item.description: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said a thriving India strengthens global stability as New Delhi and Brussels push to finalise a long-awaited free trade agreement during Republic Day 2026.

item.title: Bangladesh Reacts Sharply To Sheikh Hasina’s Delhi Speech, Warns Of Political Fallout
item.description: Bangladesh’s interim government has expressed shock and concern over exiled former prime minister Sheikh Hasina’s public address from Delhi, warning it could destabilise the country ahead of upcoming elections and strain India–Bangladesh ties.

item.title: Samsung Galaxy S25+ Charging Incident Sparks Safety Concerns; Company Promises Full Support to Affected User
item.description: A reportedly overheated Galaxy S25+ caught fire while charging overnight, prompting Samsung to investigate and offer compensation to the affected user.
